en.flavor: A catalyst carved out of the hard jade from Jueyun Karst north of Liyue. Small, light, and durable, it is known more colloquially as the "jade ball."

refinements.1: Upon causing a Vaporize, Electro-Charged, Frozen, Bloom, Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, or a Hydro-infused Swirl reaction, ATK is increased by <r>20%</r> for 12s.
refinements.2: Upon causing a Vaporize, Electro-Charged, Frozen, Bloom, Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, or a Hydro-infused Swirl reaction, ATK is increased by <r>25%</r> for 12s.
refinements.3: Upon causing a Vaporize, Electro-Charged, Frozen, Bloom, Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, or a Hydro-infused Swirl reaction, ATK is increased by <r>30%</r> for 12s.
refinements.4: Upon causing a Vaporize, Electro-Charged, Frozen, Bloom, Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, or a Hydro-infused Swirl reaction, ATK is increased by <r>35%</r> for 12s.
refinements.5: Upon causing a Vaporize, Electro-Charged, Frozen, Bloom, Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, or a Hydro-infused Swirl reaction, ATK is increased by <r>40%</r> for 12s.

fr.flavor: Un catalyseur sculpté dans la jadéite, produite au Karst Jueyun, au nord de Liyue. Petit et léger, résistant et durable, les gens l'appellent souvent « Boulette de jade ».

refinements.1: Augmente l'ATQ de <r>20 %</r> pendant 12 s après avoir déclenché une réaction d'Évaporation, d'Électrocution, de Sélénocution, de Gel, de Fleurissement, de Sélénofleurissement ou de Dispersion Hydro.
